notes:
Account summary: mid-market product analytics SaaS for B2B marketplaces. Interested in improving search ranking + recommendations with a reranking endpoint. Initial preference: start on Hosted API for fast iteration, then evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation.

POC / evaluation scope:
- POC to run Feb-March: offline scoring of existing eval set (~100k query-doc pairs) to compare current BM25 + light ML ranker vs Redwood reranking.
- Need batch/offline scoring API and per-request latency profile for top-k rerank (k=50 -> return top 5).
- Quality metrics: MRR, NDCG@5, precision@3. Will provide labeled evals and production logs.
- Need support for custom feature augmentation (pass embeddings + scalar signals) into reranker request.

Technical / performance requirements:
- Online latency SLO: 50-150ms p95 for rerank of 50 candidates (target 100ms p95).
- Throughput: bursts up to 200 req/s during peak; baseline ~30 req/s.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget — looking to keep hosted costs < $X/token-equivalent; open to Dedicated if unit cost falls and SLA met.

Security & compliance:
- SOC2 required, SSO/SAML mandatory, audit logs, EU data residency for some customers. Interested in KMS integration for key management.
